decisive_items: a well-defined, nonenhancing, unilocular hypodense cystic lesion
both lesions appeared homogeneous, T1 hypointense, T2 hyperintense, and showed no wall enhancement
a narrow neck traversing the pelvic floor near the pudendal canal
response.rationale: The nonenhancing homogeneous unilocular perineal/presacral cyst with translevator extension and no inflammatory signs best fits an epidermoid cyst. Tarlov cyst would be a sacral/intraspinal nerve-root cyst, and pilonidal cyst would typically show inflammation/drainage absent here.

rejected.why: Tarlov cyst is a sacral perineural cyst; this lesion is anterior to the rectum and perineal with a translevator neck, not localized to the sacral canal/foramen.
Pilonidal cyst is excluded by the lack of drainage, erythema, fever, and systemic symptoms, as well as by nonenhancing homogeneous cysts rather than an inflamed sinus/abscess.
